vulnerability.explanation: When parsing the -a option, the code increments argi and immediately uses argv[argi] without verifying that another argument exists. If -a is the last argument, argv[argi] is NULL and passing it to fopen leads to a NULL pointer dereference inside libc. Subsequent uses of argv[argi] with %s would also dereference NULL.
